cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: sulfate-free architecture dominated by mild amino-acid/nonionic/amphoteric routes - Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate #2, Decyl Glucoside #3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4, Coco-Glucoside #9 - with no alkyl(ether) sulfate and meaningful refatting (Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil #7, Hydrogenated Castor Oil #12). Limited anionic reset.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: taurate is an effective anionic primary and the system is balanced; 'sulfate-free does not automatically mean low'

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: multiple complementary systems - Hydrolyzed Keratin #6, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil #7, Amodimethicone #10, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #11, Hydrogenated Castor Oil #12, pearlizing Glycol Distearate #15 - all before the preservatives.

weightPotential.rationale: High: depositionLoad high (early argan oil #7, amodimethicone #10, guar #11, hydrogenated castor oil #12, keratin #6), persistence moderate-high (amodimethicone, waxy castor), resetCapacity weak (mild taurate/glucoside system). Multiple converging persistent systems with limited reset.
weightPotential.counterSignal: W1-style silicone+guar formulas can be moderate; here the cleansing base is not an effective sulfate/betaine base, so W1 does not apply
weightPotential.whyThisBand: converging oil + aminosilicone + cationic + waxy lipid with weak reset
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate requires reset or limited richness arguing against coating; neither present

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: 'Strength & Length + Keratin Oil' name and claims 'Anti-Haarbruch', 'strapaziertes Haar', 'reduziert Spliss', 'repariert'; verdict repair_supported from a coherent damage-care/deposition cluster (Hydrolyzed Keratin #6, Amodimethicone #10, argan oil #7, guar #11).

careDirection.limitation: breakage figures are shampoo+conditioner claims; rinse-off

focusPrimary.counterSignal: positioning is retailer-only (no manufacturer source in packet)
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula repair_supported; claims consistently damage/breakage -> repair.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'Glanz' is an outcome of the same oil/aminosilicone route (F2).

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no daily/frequent, reset or treatment trigger.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W high: fine not_suited, normal acceptable, coarse ideal. Ordinary target, no T6. T4: W neighbor moderate would raise fine/normal (no flag); coarse stays ideal at W moderate with C high and at W high with C moderate -> no flag.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 low -> gentle (differs from normal bucket's regular; I2 keeps it). I3: neighbor moderate -> regular would equal the expected intensity -> review_intensity_boundary.

uncertainties: §4 low vs moderate: a taurate/glucoside/betaine system literally matches the low anchor ('amino-acid/nonionic/amphoteric routes') but also the moderate anchor ('balanced surfactant system'); the standard gives no sulfate-free anchor example. Resolved low with neighbor moderate, which raises I3.
All positioning is retailer copy; §3.2/§7 do not grade focus claims by source tier (E1 grading only applies to scalp targets).
W1 is scoped to 'effective sulfate/betaine cleansing base'; the standard does not say how to treat the same deposition stack on a mild sulfate-free base. Resolved high (weak reset).
